sentences.text: learned counsel for the parties agreed that it was a matrimonial dispute and they have settled the dispute outside the court vide compromise dated 25.05.2024.
A copy of the compromise dated 25.05.2024 is on record.
In view thereof, the matter was re-
referred to the mediation centre vide order dated 20.09.2024.

4. Perused the office report and the settlement agreement dated 25.09.2024 which indicates that matter has been peacefully settled between the parties and they have settled their differences on the terms mentioned in paragraph 7 of the settlement agreement dated 25.09.2024.

The paragraph 6 is quoted as under:-
"7. The following settlement has been arrived at between the Parties hereto:-
a) That both the parties have agreed to live separately and dissolve their marriage and in this regard they have produced a notarized Samjhutanama dated 25.05.2024,
which contains all terms and conditions of the settlement and the same shall be part of this settlement.
The aforesaid Samjhutanama dated 25.05.2024 is annexed to this settlement for kind perusal of the Hon'ble Court.
Further, the terms and conditions mentioned in aforesaid Samjhutanama, has been fulfilled.

b) That it has been agreed between the parties that the petitioner no.1-husband has already paid the amount of Mehar, Iddat, Muddat and Maintenance to the Respondent No. 4-wife, which is also mentioned in the aforesaid Samjhutanama dated 25.05.2024.

c) That it has also been agreed between the parties that all civil and criminal cases filed by them against each other regarding present matrimonial dispute shall be withdrawn by the parties concerned by taking appropriate steps before the Court/authority concerned.
d) That the parties will not file any fresh case against each other in respect of this matrimonial dispute.
They have no claim against each other in future also."

5. It is submitted that as between the parties compromise had already taken place therefore, the impugned First Information Report dated 04.01.2024 registered as Case Crime No. 09 of 2024,
under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 377, 354, 376 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act and 3/4 Protection of Muslim Women's Marriage Act, 2019, Police Station- Kithore, District Meerut is liable to be quashed.
